name: Crew
tagline: Coaching for managers on how to actually run their team
description: On setup it asks what your role is, how your team is arranged, and where things are currently stuck. From there it acts as a standing mentor, suggesting operating practices to try: how work gets handed between people, how you run your regular check-ins, and how to unblock the parts of the team that have stalled.
author: GenXer
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
